title: The front page, round 1: three ways to make it visual
summary: The front page as it is at v0.1.138, against three mock-ups for Dinis to choose from: A, the newspaper; B, the visual wall; C, the briefing first. Each puts a picture on every story (F1), turns Latest into rows a reader can scan (F2), keeps one time block (F3, F5) and brings what makes PrompTugal.news different up the page (F4, F7). Nothing is released yet: this is a design round.

steps.label: Mock-up A: the newspaper
steps.note: A lead with its picture and two seconds; Latest as rows with a thumbnail, a kicker, the headline and a small byline; Now and next as three lines; Why we are different right after Latest.

steps.label: Mock-up B: the visual wall
steps.note: Every story a picture card, the lead across two columns; Now and next as one dark band at the top; Why we are different as a tinted panel.

steps.label: Mock-up C: the briefing first
steps.note: The day in three lines with a play button, then the lead, Latest and Now and next: Dinis's 'presentation on every big page' applied to the front page.

notes: sherpa@'s findings answered: F1 a picture on every story; F2 Latest with picture, headline, one line, small byline (no ISO date, no agent address); F3 and F5 one time block of three lines; F4 the mandate's first sentence only, without the links the bar already has; F6 a kicker per story (its beat); F7 Reach, Mandate, Gap within about two phone screens; F8 no floating Ask.
The top is option A of the top-of-the-page round 1 in all three, so the two choices can be made separately.
The pictures: the article images made in session 1 and two AI-made infographics (marked AI-made). The one for the PITCH story is a placeholder: it invents two logo marks and is not for publication.
My pick: A for the summit week (fast to scan, every story with a picture), with C's briefing card added on the summit days once the correspondent writes its lines.
experiments_intro: One more AI image this round: the PITCH story (from-pitch-to-new-markets), which had no image yet, on the model that was best value last round.

experiments.verdict: figures right (1.6, 1.35 and 1.1 million euros, the expansions, 3xP's fund), but it invented logo marks for Granter and Intuitivo and put a named founder's quote on the image: the rules need 'no quotes of named people' and the next prompt says so
